purpose: Vendor-neutral operating contract for AI coding agents working with VibeSec.
pre_commit_validation_loop: run the complete repository test suite
run applicable artifact and self-scan checks
inspect the diff and confirm no prohibited action occurred
commit only when every required check passes
required_safety_rules: Synchronize from the latest main commit before feature work when the operator requests it.
Do not create another branch or pull request, push, merge, tag, or release unless the operator explicitly authorizes that exact action.
Never request credentials, personal access tokens, keychain access, administrator access, or GitHub CLI authentication.
Keep the sole aggregate required status named exactly validate.
Use reviewed open-source tools and immutable pins where execution depends on external artifacts.
Use explicit capability declarations; never infer Yes over an explicit No.
Preserve accurate coverage states and exact exit-code categories.
Do not expose secrets, authorization headers, tokens, raw sensitive scanner output, prompts, or conversations.
Do not weaken, delete, skip, or rewrite tests merely to obtain a passing result.
Prove any claimed pre-existing failure on the requested base commit.
Report the manual push command instead of pushing unless the operator explicitly authorizes a push.
